reason: Retain the unchanged 59 production files that own confinement policy, rendering and platform composition. DefaultConfinement and its ordered filesystem facts remain the policy source; the Linux helper renders those facts into mounts and Landlock, while the common launch guarantees byte-only regular standard streams, and a standard descriptor the caller closed reaches the target as the runtime null stream. The typed floor and applied command contracts support retaining this bounded module.
